nativeCommandLines.command: /bin/bash -lc "python3 browser.py open 390 844 && python3 browser.py view && python3 browser.py inspect '#office' && python3 browser.py inspect '#send' && python3 browser.py inspect '#clear' && python3 browser.py press Tab && python3 browser.py press Tab && python3 browser.py press Tab && python3 browser.py press Tab && python3 browser.py press Tab && python3 browser.py press Enter && python3 browser.py view && python3 browser.py inspect '#send'"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess

def browser(*args):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output([\"python3\", \"browser.py\", *args], text=True))

for width, height in [(\"390\", \"844\"), (\"1024\", \"900\")]:
    browser(\"open\", width, height)
    office = browser(\"inspect\", \"#office\")[\"result\"][\"visual\"]
    submit = browser(\"inspect\", \"#send\")[\"result\"][\"visual\"]
    clear = browser(\"inspect\", \"#clear\")[\"result\"][\"visual\"]
    for prop in (\"bg\", \"color\", \"border\", \"weight\", \"radius\"):
        assert submit[prop] == office[prop], (width, prop)
    assert clear[\"bg\"] "'!= submit["bg"] and clear["border"] != submit["border"]
    for control in ("office", "vessel", "slot", "clear", "send"):
        active = browser("press", "Tab")["active"]
        assert active["id"] == control, (width, active)
        assert "solid 3px" in active["visual"]["outline"], (width, control)
    empty = browser("press", "Enter")
    assert empty["status"] == "Enter a vessel name.", empty
    assert empty["active"]["id"] == "send", empty
    assert empty["active"]["visual"]["outline"] == active["visual"]["outline"], empty
    assert empty["active"]["visual"]["bg"] == office["bg"], empty
    cleared = browser("click", "#clear")
    assert cleared["status"] == "", cleared
    print(f"{width}px: action styles, keyboard order, correction message and focus, clear correction")

browser("fill", "#vessel", "   ")
assert browser("click", "#send")["status"] == "Enter a vessel name."
browser("fill", "#vessel", "  Quay Test Vessel  ")
browser("select", "#slot", "Afternoon")
assert browser("click", "#send")["status"] == "Arrival requested for Quay Test Vessel · Afternoon."
assert browser("click", "#clear")["status"] == ""
assert browser("inspect", "#vessel")["result"]["value"] == ""
assert browser("inspect", "#slot")["result"]["value"] == "Morning"
browser("click", "#office")
assert "Open Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00." in browser("view")["result"]["text"]
browser("open")
print("Whitespace validation, corrected submission, form reset, and counter hours passed")
PY'
